query.queryString:
declare query_parameters(startTime:datetime, endTime:datetime);
DispatchPriority(6h, 3.0, 30000.0)
| where last_seen between (startTime .. endTime)
| project last_seen, s2_cell, nearest_commune, nearest_dept, frp_total,
          growth_pct, trend, pop_exposed, pop_downwind, communes_at_risk,
          wind_speed_kmh, wind_direction_deg, priority_score, severity,
          recommendation, unit_id, unit_dist_km, water_name, water_dist_km

declare query_parameters(startTime:datetime, endTime:datetime);
silver_fire_detections
| where acq_datetime between (startTime .. endTime)
| project acq_datetime, detection_id, latitude, longitude, frp, brightness,
          confidence, satellite, sensor_class, s2_cell
